name: Setiptiline
summary: Setiptiline (brand name Tecipul), also known as teciptiline, is a tetracyclic antidepressant (TeCA) that acts as a noradrenergic and specific serotonergic antidepressant (NaSSA). It was launched in 1989 for the treatment of depression in Japan by Mochida.

pharmacology.text: Setiptiline acts as a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor, α2-adrenergic receptor antagonist, and serotonin receptor antagonist, likely at the 5-HT2 subtypes, as well as an H1 receptor inverse agonist/antihistamine.

uses.text: It was launched in 1989 for the treatment of depression in Japan by Mochida.
